posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
We are doing it again.

So claim heroes and after the decks are finalized I'll announce the villain.  hehehe.

You are limited to four hero decks.

 

And now the teaser:

Mobile Defense Platform, some years ago.

 

An old man steps out of the shadows.  "It is time Ivan, you must come."

"I've told you before I will not be joining your "hunt," I have work to finish here." Blade replied.

Suddenly the man was on him, with a knife to his throat.

"I am done asking Baron, you will join me, you will help me destroy our enemies."

Blade Smiled, and the old man flew across the room, the smell of electrocution was unmistakable.

"You don't give orders here," Blade loomed over the huddled form of his attacker, "I've been ready for you."

"And I you!" The man grabbed Blade by the ankle and they disappeared.

. . .
